description: Permissions for the main window. The header drags the window and the window's theme follows the app's color scheme. A click on a ready notification shows, unminimizes and focuses the window. The opener may open only GitHub pages, such as a batch's pull request, OpenAI's sign-in page, which Connect opens for a ChatGPT plan account, and Artificial Analysis's site, which the credit beside its scores links. The opener names no `http` address: the app's own open_app_page command opens loopback pages, after parsing the address, and its open_web_link command opens an `https` link from agent text after a native confirm. The dialog may open the folder panel. The app's own commands are ACL-checked (build.rs): the main window may call each of them except the preview's pick channel, which only a preview window's page calls.
